purpose: Test whether one low-dose, group-balanced, positive-only video proposal update makes the successful I-23 single adapter a materially better rollout policy while preserving its material ninth-hit branch. This gate selects a bootstrap checkpoint and the next training method; it is not an online-score estimator and does not authorize a platform submission.

parent.allowed_role: The successful I-23 E3 adapter is both the trainable policy initialization and the separately loaded frozen reference. I-23 E1/E2 and all I-24/I-25 checkpoints are forbidden.

formal_training_data.class: D(O1,O2.UserProfile,O2.Pid2Sid,O2.Pid2Caption,O2.Pid2Tag,O2.General), official-source derived and registered in ASSETS.md

locked_rollout_gate.gold_scope: complete non-history O1-known video gold set for each prompt group; any O1-known gold that also occurs in prompt history is excluded from the primary reward and retained only as a separately reported audit statistic

evaluator_mechanical_refreeze.reason: The first invocation stopped before model loading because PEFT serialized the same seven target_modules in a different JSON list order for the parent and candidates. The evaluator now canonicalizes set-like target_modules/modules_to_save lists and rejects duplicates before comparison. Before any model forward, a second audit found that the loop was only parent-first within each batch; it is now adapter-outer so the complete parent pass precedes all step64 scoring and the complete step64 pass precedes step128.

online_launcher.state: HASH_LOCKED; RELEASE IS CONTROLLED SEPARATELY BY THE LAUNCHER

frozen_training_recipe.proposal_loss: answer-only CE over domain+a+b+c+EOS plus 0.2x frozen-I23 forward KL
frozen_training_recipe.retention_loss: 4.0x frozen-I23 forward KL only, capped at 128 response positions
frozen_training_recipe.checkpoint_contents: adapter_model.safetensors and adapter_config.json only; no optimizer, scheduler, scaler, or RNG state

response_only_route_contract.proposal: Exactly one empty <think>...</think> block followed, apart from whitespace, by exactly domain+s_a+s_b+s_c and EOS. CE is applied only to domain+s_a+s_b+s_c+EOS, never to prompt or think formatting.
response_only_route_contract.retention: Every response not matching the strict proposal signature is KL-only. The trainer must fail on an ambiguous malformed empty-think recommendation rather than silently route it as retention.

locked_unrestricted_rollout_recipe.item_generation: unrestricted deterministic width-8 beam after the explicit video domain token; exactly three SID tokens
locked_unrestricted_rollout_recipe.reward: For each item candidate, max over the complete group non-history O1-known gold set of the longest contiguous prefix match length over (a,b,c), in {0,1,2,3}. Every candidate copied exactly from prompt history is masked from the primary reward. A reasoning-trace reward is the maximum unmasked candidate reward in its width-8 beam. Matches against the all-gold set including history overlaps are secondary audit statistics only.
locked_unrestricted_rollout_recipe.group_has_reward_variance: The four reasoning-trace rewards are not all equal.
locked_unrestricted_rollout_recipe.full_qc_usable_group: At least one trace closes exactly at </think>, has no nested ChatML/think control leakage, embeds no primary non-history gold answer in thought, mentions only prompt-grounded same-domain SIDs when it mentions SIDs, and yields at least one structurally valid unmasked candidate.

set_path_likelihood_protocol.prompt: Exact frozen /no_think gate prompt followed by the canonical empty-think prefix and an evaluator-supplied <|video_begin|> marker.
set_path_likelihood_protocol.scored_tokens: Teacher-force each primary non-history gold and sum only the three autoregressive s_a,s_b,s_c token log probabilities; the domain marker is context, not a scored target.
set_path_likelihood_protocol.primary_group_metric: set_logsumexp over every primary non-history gold path

checkpoint_evaluation_order: Run scripts/eval/audit_i28_multigold_set_path.py once to produce the frozen parent/step64/step128 paired JSON report. A checkpoint failing the set_logsumexp mean-delta or improved-rate gate stops there.
For each set-path pass, run the locked material and non-video retention checks plus itemic structure veto.
Run the N4xK8 unrestricted rollout gate only for checkpoints passing both the set-path and retention layers.

next_stage_branching.strict_positive_only_rft: If a retention-safe proposal-mechanism-pass candidate has at least 32/128 full-QC unrestricted exact-hit groups against the primary non-history gold sets, select the earliest such candidate and authorize only a separately preregistered strict exact-positive RFT build.
next_stage_branching.partial_reward_round_grpo: Otherwise, select the earliest retention-safe proposal-mechanism-pass candidate and authorize only a separately preregistered single-round hierarchical-prefix GRPO smoke. Do not train on the diagnostic rollout JSONL.
next_stage_branching.close: If neither checkpoint passes all retention and proposal mechanism requirements, close I-28 locally. Do not loosen thresholds, enlarge beam width post hoc, resume a checkpoint, or spend a platform submission.

selection_rule: First finish and audit the full 128-step trajectory. Score the frozen I-23 parent before candidates, then audit step64 and step128 with exactly the same locked manifests and decode. Prefer the earliest checkpoint eligible for strict positive-only RFT; if none is RFT-eligible, choose the earliest checkpoint eligible for partial-reward GRPO. A later checkpoint cannot replace an earlier checkpoint within the same branch merely because its offline likelihood gain is larger.
submission_budget_rule: I-28 proposal checkpoints are bootstrap policies, not daily platform candidates. Spend zero of the team's approximately three daily submissions on I-28 unless a later separately preregistered final model passes its own submission gate.
interpretation_boundary: The primary multi-positive likelihood metric is group set-logprob, computed as logsumexp over all non-history O1-known gold paths. Best-gold likelihood is only a diagnostic and cannot satisfy that mechanism gate by itself. All holdout and rollout diagnostics are selection/veto evidence only. They do not certify the discontinuous material ninth hit, predict an online score, or become training data. O3-constrained results may be reported separately as diagnostics but can never satisfy a primary gate.
